title: When a Home Delivery Pharmacy Charge Falls Past Due
content:
## Payment methods notice: the waiting period before a charge is past due

**Notice.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, a charge falls past due after a waiting period that depends on how the member last paid: two whole months after shipment when the member's most recent payment was made with an HSA/FSA card, because such card charges need claim substantiation; as soon as it ships when the most recent payment was made by check, because check payers are billed by statement with charges due on receipt; and one whole month after shipment in every other case.

The member's most recent payment is the latest member payment posted on the account, whatever its kind; its payment method decides the waiting period. A member charge or expedited fee counts as past due once it is at least the waiting period old on the handling date.

### Waiting period by the most recent payment

| Payment method of the member's most recent payment | Charge falls past due |
|---|---|
| HSA/FSA card | two whole months after shipment |
| Check | as soon as it ships |
| Credit card, debit card or any other | one whole month after shipment |

### Hypothetical charges (handling date 20 June)

| Charge dated | Most recent payment by HSA/FSA card | by check | by credit card |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | not past due | past due | not past due |
| 5 May | not past due | past due | past due |
| 2 April | past due | past due | past due |
